name: Renewal Engine
stage: Planning; task contracts prepared, execution and product implementation not approved or completed

waves.title: Know what must survive
waves.outcome: Choose one migration and define its behavior boundary.

waves.title: Understand and propose a narrow change
Compare behavior, including failures
waves.outcome: Make evidence stronger than a successful build.

waves.title: Recipes other maintainers can trust
waves.outcome: Turn the single migration into a contribution format.

waves.title: An ecosystem that stays maintainable
waves.outcome: Validate sustained use and recipe quality.

tasks.title: Select and document the reference migration
tasks.goal: Pick a maintained open-source fixture and a bounded dependency or framework change.
acceptanceCriteria: Record licensing, source revisions, supported runtime and the specific migration objective.
List behavior that must remain stable and areas that are intentionally out of scope.
tasks.body:
Pick a maintained open-source fixture and a bounded dependency or framework change.
